newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Prague RPIX index closes 3.6 pts lower at 1,025.2.
newsitem.headline: Prague RPIX index closes 3.6 pts lower at 1,025.2.

text.p: 1200 gmt - Prague real-time trading session ends in negative territory as losses in shares in two of the three high-caps, SPT Telecom and Komercni Banka, push Reuters RPIX index down 3.6 points to 1,025.2
* Komercni down 27 crowns to 1,578 as flood worries affecting debt repayments drag down medium-term outlook. KB shares are down from 1,854 just before the flooding began on July 4
* SPT loses 33 crowns to 3,635, while CEZ a.s. nudges up just one crown to 900
* Six of the 11 top shares trading in real-time session posted loses, four showed gains, while one was unchanged.
